provenance.note: Salem district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope salem-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-salem). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: NH 544H, Mettur
properties.description: Outfall OF2, 'NH 544H, Mettur': one of the 11 sewage outfall points TNPCB's 2019 Cauvery action plan maps for Mettur Municipality (p.16; 11 locations, p.30); the plan records that the sewage not treated at the STPs 'is now being discharged into River Cauvery' (p.15). Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.17).

properties.name: Poolampatti Town Panchayat
properties.description: Outfall OF1, 'Poolampatti Town Panchayat', captioned 'Outfalls near Slaughter House in Poolampatti' (p.87): the first of the 19 outfalls TNPCB's 2019 Cauvery action plan identifies on the Kumarapalayam office's 60.4 km reach, which begins at Poolampatti in Edapadi taluk (p.84). The plan's Salem table gives Poollampatty Town Panchayat 5 outfall locations, its sullage 'let out in to private Agriculture land' (pp.31-32). Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.85).

properties.name: Thathiyampatti Bridge
properties.description: Sewage outfall 1, 'Thathiyampatti Bridge' (Village Panchayat): one of the six sewage outfall points TNPCB's 2019 Sarabanga action plan prints (p.9), on the stretch where it finds 'only domestic sewage from Idappadi Municipality, Thathiampatti Village Panchayat and Omalur Town Panchayat area' (p.7). Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.9).

properties.name: BelurBridge
properties.description: Sewage outfall 5, 'BelurBridge' (Belur Town Panchayat): one of the five sewage outfall points TNPCB's 2019 Vasista action plan prints (p.10); the plan finds the river's pollution 'mainly due to the discharge of domestic sewage into the river' from these local bodies (p.6). Its printed position lies on CWC's Anaimaduvu line, which WRD describes as a tributary of the Vasista (TN WRD, Anaimaduvu Dam page), 5.8 km from CWC's Vasishta line. Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.10).
